i_bee_eater.names.legendary: Waggle, Bane of the Busy Bee
i_bee_eater.lore.uncommon: Digs its nest tunnel in a sandy riverbank, so it comes out every morning with sand in its feathers and a grumpy face.
i_bee_eater.lore.legendary: Flew in from Africa every summer for so long that the bees started arriving a week late on purpose.

x_falcon.lore.epic: Moved onto the tallest office block in the city, and the window cleaners now book appointments around its nap.

x_prawn.lore.common: Is so see-through that you can watch its breakfast going down. It really wishes you would look away.

x_salmon.lore.common: Turns up at the river mouth every autumn and waits for the tide like it is queuing for a bus.
x_salmon.lore.uncommon: Was born in a river, grew up in the sea, and still complains that the sea is far too salty.
x_salmon.lore.epic: Leapt up the salmon ladder so fast that the fish counter at the dam ran out of numbers.

x_narwhal.lore.epic: Held an underwater jousting match with twenty other narwhals. The icebergs now have notches like a measuring stick.

x_pelican.lore.epic: Herded the fish into the shallows with fifty friends in a perfect horseshoe. The harbour master has asked them to run the fishing fleet.

x_pheasant.lore.epic: Crowed and clattered its wings so loudly at dawn that every rooster in the valley gave up in shame.

x_toucan.lore.rare: Flipped a mango into the air, caught it, and flicked the stone straight into the zookeeper's tea.
x_toucan.lore.legendary: Uses its huge beak as a radiator to cool down, and kept the whole jungle hut chilly all summer.

fish.lore.epic: Jumped out of its bowl into the big tank next door and declared itself the new boss. The angelfish take turns to complain.
fish.lore.legendary: Lived forty years in the same bowl, outlasting three castles and two plastic divers, and is still surprised by the castle.

x_vulture.lore.common: Spreads its huge wings in the morning sun to warm up, as if it is waiting for a round of applause.
x_vulture.lore.epic: Rode one warm air current with fifty friends, and the hot-air balloons had to queue behind them.

x_manta_ray.lore.legendary: Has the biggest brain of any fish and recognises itself in a mirror, so it spends ages fixing its fins before every dive.

i_bustard.lore.common: Walks everywhere very slowly to save energy, and is deeply offended whenever a hare overtakes it.
i_bustard.lore.legendary: Took off at one end of the plain and landed at the other. The ground has asked for some warning next time.
i_bustard.lore.epic: Landed on the village cricket pitch with such a thump that the bails fell off at both ends.

starfish.lore.legendary: Grew a whole new starfish from one lost arm. The two of them still argue about which one is the original.
starfish.lore.uncommon: Has a tiny eye at the tip of every arm, so it always knows who is sneaking up, from any direction.

i_gar.lore.legendary: Has looked exactly the same for a hundred million years, and says it is waiting for fashion to come back round.
i_gar.lore.rare: Gulps air at the surface so loudly that anglers spin round looking for whoever burped.

i_grey_whale.lore.legendary: Swims from the icy north to the warm south and back every year, and still gets grumpy if another whale is in its favourite lagoon.
i_grey_whale.lore.uncommon: Swims right up to the little boats in the lagoon and waits to have its head scratched like a very large dog.
i_grey_whale.lore.epic: Scooped up so much seabed in one dive that it left whale-shaped pits for the crabs to move into.

x_sea_turtle.lore.common: Naps on the reef for so long between swims that the fish have opened a little cafe on its shell.

i_bald_eagle.lore.uncommon: Has a fierce face but a squeaky little call, so it glares extra hard to make up for it.
i_bald_eagle.lore.rare: Only gets its white head at five years old, and spends the years before that insisting it is not a teenager.

i_junco.lore.legendary: Has worn the same grey suit with a white belly every day of its life, and was finally voted best dressed by the snowmen.

i_ptarmigan.lore.rare: Dives into a snowdrift to sleep in a snug little cave, and will not come out for anyone holding a shovel.
i_ptarmigan.lore.epic: Croaked so much like a creaky door that every mountain hut on the pass checked its hinges.

owl.lore.epic: Moved into the old barn, and every mouse in the county stayed indoors for the whole winter.

i_brain_coral.lore.legendary: Has been growing for nine hundred years and is now the size of a car. The fish call it the library.

x_whale_shark.lore.uncommon: Is the biggest fish in the ocean but only eats the tiniest things in it. Its dinner plate would be a thimble.
x_whale_shark.lore.legendary: Swam so slowly past the dive boat that the divers had lunch, a nap and a second dive before its tail went by.

x_clam.lore.epic: Clamped onto a paddler's welly and would not let go, so she spent the whole holiday walking with a loud click.

x_anemone.lore.rare: Fires sticky threads at anything that touches it, so every curious shrimp gets a surprise handshake.
x_anemone.lore.legendary: Walked very slowly across the reef on its one foot to find a better view. It took a year, and the view was worth it.

x_gosling.lore.rare: Paddled off for its first swim the day it hatched, and spent the afternoon telling the ducks how easy it was.

duck.lore.legendary: Slept with one eye open for so long that it watched the whole park being rebuilt. It has notes about the new benches.

i_coucal.lore.rare: Clambers through the hedge so clumsily that the gardener thinks a dog is stuck in it.
i_coucal.lore.legendary: Is a cuckoo that actually raises its own chicks, and tells every other cuckoo about it, loudly, all summer.

i_ruffed_grouse.lore.legendary: Walked across the whole snowy forest on its fringed winter toes, and the snowshoe hares asked for the pattern.

x_eagle.lore.epic: Flapped once over the ski slope, and every skier went down the mountain twice as fast as they meant to.
x_eagle.lore.legendary: Has been drawn on so many flags and shields that it now refuses to be painted from its bad side.

x_hawk.lore.uncommon: Has a brick-red tail and flicks it like a cape every time it lands on a fence post.
x_hawk.lore.epic: Circled above the school sports day so long that every child ran the egg-and-spoon race looking up.
x_hawk.names.legendary: Screecher Supreme, Voice of Every Eagle

i_american_egret.lore.common: Stands perfectly still in the pond for so long that people think it is a garden ornament.
i_american_egret.lore.epic: Shuffled its feet in the shallows so hard that every fish in the marsh shot onto the bank and asked for a towel.
i_american_egret.lore.legendary: Grew such magnificent white plumes that every swan on the lake booked a hairdresser.
i_american_egret.lore.rare: Tosses every fish in the air to swallow it head-first. Misses about once a week and calls it a juggling trick.

x_heron.lore.uncommon: Flies with its neck folded into an S, so it always looks like it has just remembered something embarrassing.

i_little_blue_heron.lore.epic: Waded into the town fountain and fished so calmly that a crowd gathered. It caught one fish, bowed, and flew off.

x_kingfisher.lore.legendary: Dug a tunnel into the riverbank so long that it came out in the village bakery. It now dives for doughnuts.
x_kingfisher.lore.epic: Dived so cleanly that engineers copied its beak for a high-speed train. Now it races the train every morning and wins.

i_barracouta.lore.rare: Bites straight through fishing line, then hangs around the boat to see whether you have any more.
i_barracouta.lore.epic: Followed a fishing boat all the way into harbour and tried to buy a ticket for the return trip.

i_coho.lore.legendary: Turned such a bright red for its journey home that the lighthouse switched off and let the coho do the job.
i_coho.lore.epic: Jumped so many waterfalls in one week that the river put up a sign saying PLEASE USE THE STAIRS.

x_trout.lore.legendary: Swam up the waterfall into the mountain lake and has been its only fish for so long that it thinks it invented water.

i_sulphur_crested_cockatoo.lore.epic: Chewed through every wooden balcony railing on the street in one week. The builders now arrive with metal ones and a nervous look.
i_sulphur_crested_cockatoo.lore.legendary: Lived past a hundred, outlasting three owners, two houses and every bin lid ever designed to stop it.
i_sulphur_crested_cockatoo.lore.uncommon: Raises its yellow crest when it is excited, so the whole street knows it has found something it should not have.
i_sulphur_crested_cockatoo.lore.common: Hangs upside down from the gutter to stare in at breakfast, then screams when nobody shares.

x_cockatoo.lore.epic: Unscrewed every handle in the kitchen while the family slept. Breakfast took an hour to get into.
x_cockatoo.lore.legendary: Gives off so much fine feather dust that the whole house looks freshly floured. The bakery next door asked for the recipe.

i_african_grey.lore.rare: Can count to six and name every colour, so it always knows exactly how many biscuits you hid, and where.

x_parrot.lore.epic: Taught every parrot in the pet shop to shout SHOP! at once. The owner has run to the counter four hundred times today.
x_parrot.lore.common: Chews every pencil, remote and wooden spoon in the house into neat little splinters.

x_starling.lore.rare: Walks across the lawn stabbing its beak in and opening it wide, like a very busy garden fork.
x_starling.lore.legendary: Copied the ice-cream van tune so perfectly that every child on the estate ran outside. The van is thinking about a new song.

x_raven.lore.epic: Played catch with a fox across the castle lawn for an hour. The tourists cheered and the fox demanded a rematch.

x_macaw.lore.rare: Licks the clay riverbank every morning to settle its tummy after too many unripe seeds. Calls it pudding.

x_parakeet.lore.legendary: Built one shared nest for a hundred families in a single tree. The tree was given its own postcode.

x_duckling.lore.epic: Jumped out of its nest high in a tree and bounced off the lawn like a ball. The neighbours opened a trampoline park in its honour.

i_american_coot.lore.legendary: Built a floating nest out of reeds and crisp packets so big that the park added it to the map as an island.
i_american_coot.lore.epic: Fought a rival coot by sitting back and kicking water at it for an hour. The rowing club stopped to cheer.

x_stork.lore.epic: Built a nest on top of an electricity pylon so big that the engineers added a special platform just for it.
x_stork.lore.rare: Has no real voice, so it clatters its beak like a wooden rattle whenever it wants to join a conversation.

i_white_stork.lore.rare: Decorates its nest with whatever it finds, and the village has quietly lost one sock from every washing line.
i_white_stork.lore.legendary: Delivered so many bundles to the village, according to the old stories, that the postman has asked it to cover weekends.

i_black_stork.lore.uncommon: Wears a bright red beak and red legs with an all-black suit, and insists it is not dressed for a party.
i_black_stork.lore.epic: Crossed the whole Sahara on warm air without a single flap, then complained about the sand in its feathers.

x_crane_bird.lore.legendary: Flew over the highest mountains in the world with its flock, then grumbled that they could have been a bit lower.
x_crane_bird.lore.common: Throws sticks in the air and catches them for no reason, then looks round to see who was impressed.
x_crane_bird.lore.epic: Gathered with ten thousand cranes on one lake, and their trumpeting rattled every window in the valley for a week.

x_flamingo.lore.legendary: Built a mud nest shaped like a little volcano, and soon every flamingo on the lake copied it. The lake now looks like a tiny mountain range.
x_flamingo.lore.epic: Marched sideways in a tight crowd with a thousand flamingos, and the boating lake had to close for the parade.

i_red_backed_sandpiper.lore.epic: Paddled its feet in the mud so fast that worms popped up all along the beach to see what the noise was.

x_albatross.lore.legendary: Is still raising chicks at seventy and has worn out four sets of leg rings. The scientists bring each new ring as a birthday present.

i_dowitcher.lore.uncommon: Has a beak almost as long as its body and keeps knocking on things it did not mean to.
i_dowitcher.lore.rare: Feels worms through the mud with the very tip of its beak, so it finds dinner with its eyes shut, and often does.
i_dowitcher.lore.epic: Landed on the mudflat with ten thousand friends all stitching at once. The dog walkers thought the beach had started to purr.

x_kiwi_bird.lore.epic: Snuffled so loudly round the campsite at night that every tent zipped itself shut.

whale.lore.legendary: Swallowed a krill swarm the size of a swimming pool in one gulp, then burped up a small rain cloud.

i_rock_beauty.lore.rare: Turns from yellow with a black spot as a baby to mostly black as a grown-up, and says it is just going through a phase.
i_rock_beauty.lore.epic: Nibbled every sponge on the reef in one week, and the divers came up asking where all the furniture had gone.

i_ruddy_turnstone.lore.epic: Ate the leftover chips off every bench on the seafront before the seagulls woke up. The seagulls now set alarms.
i_ruddy_turnstone.lore.legendary: Flew from the Arctic to Australia and flipped one stone at every stop, just in case. Says it has nearly finished.

x_blackbird.lore.epic: Stripped every cherry off the orchard the night before picking day. The farmer harvested a lot of stones.

i_water_ouzel.lore.rare: Blinks its bright white eyelids while bobbing, like a tiny lighthouse flashing messages to the fish.
i_water_ouzel.lore.epic: Built its mossy nest right behind a waterfall, so every visitor gets soaked just to say hello.
i_water_ouzel.lore.legendary: Sang right through the roar of the loudest waterfall in the mountains, and the waterfall turned itself down to listen.

i_redshank.lore.rare: Sweeps its beak through the shallows like a metal detector and beeps proudly whenever it finds a shrimp.
i_redshank.lore.legendary: Nested beside the eighteenth hole and made every golfer tiptoe past for a whole summer. Nobody has ever played so quietly.

i_spoonbill.lore.rare: Has a bald greenish head, which it says keeps it cool and is definitely a fashion choice.
i_spoonbill.lore.epic: Roosted with two hundred friends in one tree, which turned so pink that the tourists photographed it as blossom.
i_spoonbill.lore.legendary: Was hired by the finest restaurant in town to stir its soup. Nobody else has been allowed near the pot since.

i_oystercatcher.lore.epic: Laid its eggs in the middle of the seafront car park, and the whole town parked somewhere else for a month.
i_oystercatcher.lore.rare: Hammers limpets off the rocks with such a rat-a-tat that the woodpeckers want to know who the new drummer is.

i_brambling.lore.legendary: Swaps its orange winter feathers for a smart black head every spring, and was let into a fancy restaurant without a tie.

i_bulbul.lore.rare: Has a bright red patch under its tail and sits facing away from you so you cannot miss it.
i_bulbul.lore.legendary: Built its nest in a hanging flowerpot and would not let anyone water the plant all spring. The petunias are very thirsty.

i_hornbill.lore.epic: Stripped a whole fig tree in one visit, and the forest had to wait until next year for pudding.
i_hornbill.lore.uncommon: Has a big hollow helmet on its beak, so its calls echo like someone shouting into a bucket.

i_indigo_bunting.lore.rare: Learns its song from the bird next door, so whole streets of buntings sing with the same accent.
i_indigo_bunting.lore.epic: Turned up at the woodland edge with a hundred blue friends, and the bluebell walk was cancelled because nobody could tell which was which.

i_jacamar.lore.rare: Sits so still on one branch that it can wait an hour for the perfect insect, then claims it was meditating.
i_jacamar.lore.epic: Dug its nest tunnel into a termite mound, and the termites spent a week asking who had moved in upstairs.

i_partridge.lore.common: Runs instead of flying away, then hides behind a cow as if it was never there.
i_partridge.lore.epic: Laid twenty eggs in one nest and the whole field had to tiptoe for a month.

i_prairie_chicken.lore.epic: Booms from the same hill every spring, and has done for so long that the map now calls it Boom Hill.
i_prairie_chicken.lore.rare: Raises two feather tufts on its head like horns, and is very disappointed when nobody runs away.

i_black_grouse.lore.rare: Has bright red eyebrows that swell up when it shows off, so it always looks surprised at itself.
i_black_grouse.lore.epic: Held a staring match with a rival for so long that the sheep built a little grandstand.

x_chick.lore.legendary: Hatched, looked around and announced it was in charge. The farmyard has run on time ever since.
x_chick.names.legendary: Little Clucky, Boss of the Barnyard

penguin.lore.epic: Jumped off the ice edge first, and ten thousand penguins followed it into the sea like a very long, very wet queue.

x_emu.lore.epic: Walked along a fence for a thousand kilometres looking for a gap, and the farmers named the fence after it.

x_ostrich.lore.legendary: Has eyes bigger than its brain, the biggest of any land animal, and still cannot remember where it put its egg.

x_swordfish.lore.epic: Warms its own eyes to see in the cold deep sea, and spotted a lost anchor from half a mile away.

x_puffin.lore.legendary: Has met the same partner at the same burrow every spring for twenty years, and still brings her a flower, which is a fish.

x_quail.lore.epic: Laid so many eggs in one spring that the farm shop now sells only tiny boxes.
x_quail.lore.legendary: Crossed the whole sea at night in one flock, and the lighthouse keeper counted them instead of sheep and slept for a week.

x_scallop.lore.rare: Grows a new ring on its shell every year, so it knows its exact age and announces it at every birthday.

x_sea_sponge.lore.epic: Pumped so much seawater through itself in one day that the tide came in ten minutes late.

x_seahorse.lore.legendary: Changed colour to match every shade of seaweed in the bay. The divers have been looking for it since last summer.

x_stingray.lore.rare: Sucks clams out of the sand like a vacuum cleaner and leaves the empty shells in a tidy pile.

x_guppy.lore.legendary: Was sent to a tropical island to eat mosquitoes, and ate so many that the island now sleeps without nets.

x_goldfish_bowl.lore.rare: Hums when you run a wet finger round its rim, so the goldfish has started requesting songs.
x_goldfish_bowl.lore.legendary: Has held the same goldfish for twenty years, and the goldfish still thinks every lap is a brand new holiday.

x_nautilus.lore.common: Sticks to a rock with its tentacles to sleep, and snores out bubbles all night.
x_nautilus.lore.rare: Has ninety little tentacles and no suckers, so it holds hands with everything by accident.

x_coral.lore.legendary: Spawned with every coral on the reef on one moonlit night, and the sea turned into a snow globe.

jellyfish.lore.legendary: Turns back into a baby whenever it gets old, and refuses to tell anyone its real age.
jellyfish.lore.rare: Has no brain at all and still beats everyone at floating. Says thinking is overrated.

x_pufferfish.lore.epic: Drew a giant pattern in the sand with its fins to impress a date, and the divers thought aliens had landed.

shark.lore.legendary: Has swum the oceans since before there were trees, and still thinks trees are a passing fad.

x_orca.lore.legendary: Led the family pod for nearly a hundred years, and still decides where everyone has lunch.

dolphin.lore.epic: Taught its whole pod to surf the bow waves of every boat in the bay. The sailing school has lost all its pupils to them.

x_catfish.lore.uncommon: Has taste buds all over its body, so it can taste the mud just by lying in it, and it loves the taste.
x_catfish.lore.legendary: Has lived under the old bridge for so long that the town put it on the welcome sign. It still eats the bread meant for the ducks.

x_cod.lore.rare: Has a single whisker on its chin and strokes it like a very wise old professor.
x_cod.lore.epic: Laid millions of eggs in one go, and the North Sea briefly looked like tapioca.

x_dodo.lore.legendary: Became the most famous bird that nobody has seen in ages, and has started signing autographs anyway.

i_limpkin.lore.epic: Left so many empty snail shells on the riverbank that hermit crabs came inland to go house-hunting.
i_limpkin.lore.legendary: Limped so stylishly through the swamp that every heron started copying the walk. It is now a dance craze.

i_european_gallinule.lore.epic: Climbed the reeds like a ladder and was found on top of the boathouse roof, looking innocent.
i_european_gallinule.lore.legendary: Holds its food in one foot like a sandwich, and was finally invited to the lakeside cafe, where it ordered everything with its toes.

bird.lore.epic: Gathered every sparrow in town on one telephone wire, which sagged so low that the postman had to limbo under it.
bird.lore.legendary: Sang so sweetly from the TV aerial that the whole street turned its radios off for the summer. The radio station sent a sulky letter.

x_krill.lore.legendary: Has more of itself in the ocean than there are people on land, and still gets lost in a teaspoon.

octopus.lore.legendary: Learned eight hobbies at once, one per arm, and still dropped the knitting the moment someone opened a jar.

x_canary.lore.epic: Sang so loudly from the open window that the whole street stopped its cars and joined in the chorus.
